group_note: All six are plain_mcq and all six are single_step: one stem, four short answers, no lettered block and no result carried forward. The reader's grouping on structure=plain holds for every member. The demand axis is recall for five. q097 alone is concept_discrimination, and the stated difference is that its three wrong options are the three benefits the source attributes to inbreeding, so the question turns on separating two named breeding strategies rather than retrieving one fact; q101's clinical framing was examined for the same reason and rejected, since the stored antibody-to-globulin association settles it with no rule applied, so it stays recall. E2 was set from the options alone and is name_or_identify for five, which offer bare names, terms or stages; q097 is pick_cause_or_effect because its options are rival reasons completing the stem's "because it". Content shapes differ by material. The dominant trap device across the packet is an option carrying a true fact about a different member of the same family, and it is labelled other_one_fact in every case it appears: inbreeding's benefits in q097, other hagfish genera in q099, another bacterial structure in q100, other plasma proteins in q101. Where the family itself is wrong rather than the member, the label changes to true_but_out_of_scope (the algal holdfast and moss rhizoids in q100, invertebrate haemocytes in q101), and where the event is placed at the wrong moment of one timeline it is wrong_site_or_stage (all three wrong options of q102). q098 is the only member whose options are near-identical phrases, which is why single_word_substitution appears there and nowhere else. Every wrong option in this packet carries a nameable route, so no option is left untagged. No trap sits on an official answer, and no option carries two traps.
